scripts.build:paste-helper: mkdir -p bin packages/desktop/bin && clang -O2 -framework ApplicationServices packages/desktop/electron/native/paste.c -o bin/paste-helper && cp bin/paste-helper packages/desktop/bin/paste-helper
scripts.build:fn-poll: mkdir -p bin packages/desktop/bin && clang -O2 -framework ApplicationServices packages/desktop/electron/native/fn-poll.c -o bin/fn-poll && cp bin/fn-poll packages/desktop/bin/fn-poll
scripts.setup: bun install && bun run build:whisper-addon && bun run build:paste-helper && bun run build:fn-poll && cd packages/desktop && bun install
